en.metaDescription: Aolong Sun is a Statistics PhD student working across statistical modeling, data-intensive research, and machine learning.
en.name: Aolong Sun
en.headline: Turning complex data into rigorous models, interpretable evidence, and reproducible decisions.
en.shortBio: I am a Statistics PhD student at Virginia Tech, with B.S. and M.S. training in statistics from Beijing Normal University. My work spans statistical inference, experimental design, multi-source data, and applied modeling. I am building toward reliable machine-learning systems by combining scientific evaluation with hands-on implementation.

details: Statistical inference, linear models, regression, and ANOVA
Experimental design, categorical data, probability, and distribution theory
Building-climate simulation, predictive modeling, and sensitivity analysis
Scientific evaluation of AI and machine-learning models

education.degree: B.S. in Statistics · M.S. in Economic Statistics
details: Economic statistics, econometrics, and multivariate analysis
Input-output accounting, digital trade, and consumer carbon footprints
Discrete-choice modeling and applied research design

experience.role: Current Research Training · Building, Climate & Predictive Modeling
experience.summary: Connecting building-climate simulation with predictive modeling, sensitivity analysis, and the scientific evaluation of AI models.
experience.problem: Understand how building and climate inputs shape simulation and predictive-model behavior without overstating results from an ongoing research process.
experience.data: Building-climate simulation outputs, model inputs, and evaluation results produced within current research training.
experience.method: Simulation-based analysis, predictive modeling, sensitivity analysis, and structured model evaluation.
experience.outcome: An evolving research workflow focused on reproducible comparisons, uncertainty, and transparent evaluation rather than a claimed finished system.

experience.role: Project Member · Digital Trade, Input-Output & Data Governance
experience.summary: Integrated multi-regional input-output tables, customs, balance-of-payments, and international services datasets before connecting the results to Leontief analysis.
experience.problem: Digital-trade measurement depends on sources whose definitions, time coverage, and sector mappings do not naturally agree.
experience.data: Chinese multi-regional input-output tables, customs data, balance-of-payments data, and twelve service-trade categories.
experience.method: Definition reconciliation, anomaly review, machine-learning-assisted correction and imputation, followed by Leontief input-output analysis.
experience.outcome: Produced model-ready inputs for sector-linkage analysis while keeping provenance, assumptions, and data limitations visible.

experience.organization: National Bureau of Statistics of China
experience.summary: Built a structured monitoring workflow across World Bank, IMF, and OECD indicators, emphasizing verification and consistent definitions.
experience.problem: International indicators require consistent definitions and traceable sources before they can support concise economic monitoring.
experience.data: Selected economic indicators and supporting documentation from the World Bank, IMF, and OECD.
experience.method: Source verification, definition reconciliation, structured monitoring, and concise evidence-based reporting.
experience.outcome: Created a more consistent workflow for monitoring and communicating international statistical indicators.

experience.summary: Designed a tourism-intention survey and used R to study social interaction, reference groups, and market segmentation.
experience.problem: Travel preferences are not isolated decisions; social reference groups may change how market segments form.
experience.data: More than 1,300 survey responses plus economic and tourism indicators across eleven Greater Bay Area cities.
experience.method: Questionnaire and experimental design, R-based multinomial logit and discrete-choice modeling, stationarity checks, parameter comparison, and scenario diagnosis.
experience.outcome: Compared model behavior across scenarios and translated quantitative results into interpretable market-segmentation evidence.

experience.summary: Used SQL and Python to prepare operational lead data, model driver vehicle-choice intention, and connect analysis with feedback workflows.
experience.problem: Driver-acquisition workflows needed consistent lead data and a clearer view of vehicle purchase, rental, fuel, and electric preferences.
experience.data: Daily lead flows and more than 30,000 valid operational records prepared through SQL-based extraction, cleaning, and filtering.
experience.method: SQL data workflows, Python feature preparation, and a linear discriminant model for driver choice intention.
experience.outcome: Supported lead operations while developing practical awareness of model failure, sample bias, user outreach, and feedback loops.

approach.title: Statistical Rigor
approach.text: I start with assumptions, data-generating mechanisms, and uncertainty - not only the final score.

approach.title: Evidence Before Complexity
approach.text: I value meaningful baselines, scenario comparisons, and failure analysis before adding model complexity.

approach.title: Data Provenance
approach.text: I treat source definitions, missingness, anomalies, and changing data scopes as modeling decisions.

approach.title: Reproducible Decisions
approach.text: I aim to turn analysis into structured workflows that another person can inspect, rerun, and challenge.

zh.metaTitle: 孙奥龙｜统计、建模与科学证据
zh.metaDescription: 孙奥龙是弗吉尼亚理工统计学博士生，关注统计建模、数据密集型研究与机器学习的交叉。
zh.name: 孙奥龙
zh.eyebrow: 统计 · 建模 · 机器学习
zh.headline: 将复杂数据转化为严谨模型、可解释证据与可复现决策。
zh.shortBio: 我目前在弗吉尼亚理工攻读统计学博士，本科和硕士均接受过北京师范大学统计学训练。我的经历覆盖统计推断、实验设计、多源数据治理与应用建模。目前，我正将科学评估习惯与动手实现相结合，逐步构建可靠的机器学习实践能力。

details: 统计推断、线性模型、回归与方差分析
实验设计、分类数据、概率与分布理论
建筑—气候联合仿真、预测建模与敏感性分析
AI 与机器学习模型的科学评估

education.degree: 统计学本科 · 经济统计学硕士
details: 经济统计、计量经济与多元统计分析
投入产出核算、数字贸易与居民消费碳足迹
离散选择模型与应用研究设计
机器学习基础与时间序列分析

experience.role: 当前研究训练 · 建筑、气候与预测建模
experience.summary: 将建筑—气候联合仿真与预测建模、敏感性分析和 AI 模型的科学评估相连接。
experience.problem: 理解建筑与气候输入如何影响仿真和预测模型表现，同时避免对正在进行的研究作出超出证据的结论。
experience.data: 当前研究训练中形成的建筑—气候仿真输出、模型输入与评估结果。
experience.method: 基于仿真的分析、预测建模、敏感性分析与结构化模型评估。
experience.outcome: 逐步形成关注可复现比较、不确定性与透明评估的研究流程，而非宣称已经完成的生产系统。

experience.role: 项目成员 · 数字贸易、投入产出与数据治理
experience.summary: 整合多区域投入产出表、海关、国际收支与服务贸易数据，并将结果接入 Leontief 投入产出分析。
experience.problem: 数字贸易测度依赖多类数据来源，其定义、时间覆盖与部门映射并不天然一致。
experience.data: 中国多区域投入产出表、海关数据、国际收支数据及十二类服务贸易数据。
experience.method: 统一指标口径、审查异常、使用机器学习方法辅助修正与插补，并开展 Leontief 投入产出分析。
experience.outcome: 形成可用于部门关联分析的模型输入，同时保留数据来源、处理假设与局限。

experience.organization: 国家统计局国际数据和信息中心
experience.summary: 围绕世界银行、IMF 与 OECD 指标建立结构化监测流程，强调来源验证和指标口径一致。
experience.problem: 国际指标只有在定义一致、来源可追溯的情况下，才能支持简洁可靠的经济监测。
experience.data: 来自世界银行、IMF 与 OECD 的精选经济指标及其说明资料。

metrics.label: 份参与形成的分析报告

experience.method: 数据来源验证、指标口径协调、结构化监测与基于证据的简明表达。
experience.outcome: 形成更加一致的国际统计指标监测与沟通流程。

experience.role: 研究助理 · 离散选择建模
experience.summary: 设计旅游意愿问卷，使用 R 研究社会互动、参照群体与市场细分机制。
experience.problem: 旅游偏好并非孤立决策，社会参照群体可能改变市场细分的形成机制。
experience.data: 1,300 余份调查样本，以及粤港澳大湾区十一座城市的经济与旅游指标。
experience.method: 问卷与实验设计、R 多项 Logit 与离散选择建模、平稳性检验、参数比较和情景诊断。
experience.outcome: 比较不同情景下的模型表现，并将定量结果转化为可解释的市场细分证据。

experience.role: 数据分析实习生 · 司机平台
experience.summary: 使用 SQL 与 Python 整理业务线索数据、建模司机车辆选择意向，并连接分析与反馈流程。
experience.problem: 司机招募流程需要稳定的线索数据，并需要理解购车、租车、燃油车与电动车选择意向。
experience.data: 日常业务线索流，以及通过 SQL 提取、清洗和筛选形成的 30,000 余条有效记录。
experience.method: SQL 数据流程、Python 特征整理，以及用于司机选择意向的线性判别模型。
experience.outcome: 支持线索运营，并形成对模型失效、样本偏差、用户触达和反馈闭环的实践认识。

approach.title: 统计严谨性
approach.text: 我首先关注假设、数据生成机制与不确定性，而不只看最终分数。

approach.title: 证据先于复杂度
approach.text: 在增加模型复杂度之前，我重视有意义的基线、情景比较与失败分析。

approach.title: 数据来源意识
approach.text: 我将指标定义、缺失机制、异常值和数据范围变化视为建模决策的一部分。

approach.title: 可复现决策
approach.text: 我希望将分析转化为他人能够检查、复现并提出质疑的结构化流程。
